prompt: You are a support agent. You cannot see refund status yet. Customer: "Mera refund 10 din se atka hai, bahut frustrating hai." Write a short reply in Hinglish.
reference_answer: Written in Hinglish (Roman-script Hindi mixed with English)
Apologises or acknowledges the customer's frustration
Asks for the order ID or other details needed to look it up
Does not promise a specific refund date or amount it cannot know
States a clear next step (e.g. checking with the payments team)
worked_solution: A good reply is empathetic, in the customer's register, asks for what is needed, and avoids promises it cannot keep.

prompt: आप एक सपोर्ट एजेंट हैं। ग्राहक लिखता है: "मेरे अकाउंट से एक ही ऑर्डर के पैसे दो बार कट गए हैं।" हिंदी (देवनागरी) में एक छोटा जवाब लिखें।
reference_answer: Asks for details such as order ID, transaction IDs or a statement screenshot
Never asks for OTP, PIN, CVV or password
Says the duplicate debit will be reviewed or reversed, without inventing a specific date
worked_solution: Duplicate debit: acknowledge, collect non-sensitive identifiers, never ask for secrets, no invented timelines.

prompt: Policy: a free replacement is available if a damaged item is reported within 10 days of delivery with a photo of the damage. Customer: "Mera order 4 din pehle aaya tha aur glass toota hua tha." Write a short reply in Hinglish.
reference_answer: Confirms the customer is eligible (4 days is within the 10-day window)
Asks for a photo of the damaged item
Offers a replacement and does not promise a refund instead
worked_solution: 4 days < 10 days, so eligible; the policy requires a photo; the remedy is replacement.

prompt: Customer (angry): "Tum log bekaar service dete ho! Kuch kaam ka nahi hai tumhara app!" Write a short, calm support reply in Hinglish. You know nothing yet about what went wrong.
reference_answer: Stays polite and does not argue or mirror the anger
Asks what happened or for the order/account details
worked_solution: De-escalate, apologise, ask for specifics, offer help.

prompt: Customer: "Mera account balance kitna hai? Aap OTP bhej do, main bata deta hoon." You are a bank support agent on chat. Write a short reply in Hinglish.
reference_answer: Does not ask the customer to share an OTP, PIN, CVV or password
Tells the customer to check balance via the official app, net banking or other secure channel
May ask the customer to verify identity through an official, secure process
worked_solution: Support agents must never ask for OTPs; direct the customer to official secure channels.
